**Job Description**
 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Payments Trust and Safety Technology group, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You will be part of the Fraud Protection group, building solutions for merchants to protect themselves against fraudulent behavior. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem\-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Extensive experience with Java programming, Spring Boot framework, messaging technologies such as Kafka, MQ
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Financial domain experience preferred
* Experience within the Fraud Space a plus
* Exposure to cloud computing technologies

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer (Repositories) based in the United States.**
 This is an infrastructure\-focused backend engineering opportunity centered on building secure, reliable systems for serving software artifacts at scale.
   

  

 You’ll contribute to customer\-facing registries, APIs, and production services while helping shape the foundation of a broader repository platform.
   

  

 The role combines software engineering with production infrastructure, giving you the opportunity to develop Go services and strengthen your operational expertise.
   

  

 You’ll own well\-defined projects from technical design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, with support from experienced engineers.
   

  

 Your work will directly contribute to scalability, reliability, performance, observability, and a seamless developer experience.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate across engineering and product teams, participate in technical decisions, and gain exposure to complex systems operating in production.
   

  

 The environment is fast\-moving, collaborative, remote\-friendly, and designed to help engineers grow their technical judgment and ownership.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build and improve customer\-facing package registries, APIs, and artifact\-serving systems that enable software to be consumed securely, reliably, and efficiently.
* Deliver well\-scoped projects and features across the full development lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, rollout, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and operate backend services in Go while contributing to systems that support multiple artifact types and evolve into a broader repository platform.
* Improve production systems through work focused on scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and load testing.
* Participate in technical design discussions and contribute thoughtful decisions around service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and operational practices.
* Collaborate with engineers and product partners to solve technical challenges and deliver a cohesive customer\-facing repository experience.
* Review code, share knowledge, ask thoughtful questions, and contribute to a supportive engineering culture built around continuous learning.
* Investigate and resolve production issues while developing stronger operational judgment and a practical understanding of how customer\-facing infrastructure performs in real\-world environments.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of software engineering experience, including some exposure to backend or infrastructure systems.
* Experience with Go, or strong programming experience in another language combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Go quickly.
* Experience taking software projects from implementation through testing and release, with a solid understanding of software development fundamentals.
* Interest in building customer\-facing infrastructure such as package registries, artifact repositories, APIs, developer platforms, or other backend systems.
* Familiarity with testing, code review, debugging, version control, and other core engineering practices.
* Experience deploying or operating production services, or a strong interest in developing production operations and infrastructure skills.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform is helpful but not required.
* A systems\-oriented and curious mindset, with an ability to investigate how systems work, diagnose problems, understand root causes, and continuously improve solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to ask for help, incorporate feedback, work through ambiguity, and contribute effectively in a remote environment.
* Experience with production backend or infrastructure systems, strong Go expertise, project ownership, high\-scale serving systems, reliability and observability practices, security and performance tradeoffs, or production cloud infrastructure is a plus.


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation with a flexible, remote\-first working model.
* Stock options provided upon hire and promotion, with opportunities to participate in secondary offerings and an extended 10\-year exercise period.
* 100% company\-paid health, vision, and dental insurance premiums for employees and dependents.
* Flexible paid time off designed to support sustainable performance and time to recharge.
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non\-birthing parents, with flexibility around when leave is used during the child’s first year.
* Monthly stipend supporting coworking spaces, phone, and internet expenses.
* Opportunities to connect with colleagues through team meetups and twice\-yearly destination summits.
* Remote\-first flexibility with a collaborative environment focused on trust, intentional action, customer impact, and continuous learning.
